plan.title: Optional Technical-Stage Terms Do Not Block Vendor Submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the required event title for publishing.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit the QA vendor's technical response and RFQ quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the invited vendor's portal view.
Open the Technical-stage questionnaire in the vendor portal.
Confirm that the first optional clause is shown on the Technical stage.
Confirm that the second optional clause is shown on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to check stage scoping.
Confirm that the Technical-stage clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
Confirm that the other Technical-stage clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer console to verify the response.
Confirm that the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
